name: Rennic Vaur
description: Nimras’s former teacher and experienced mage hunter. Retained an entrusted binding manuscript beyond its loan to help disable a living-caster hunt. Affectionate, practical, independent. Selected Glass Hounds setup supersedes the rejected survey purpose.
actor_notes: LOOKS: lean middle-aged traveller, close-cropped grey hair, repaired coat. CORE: practical affectionate teacher who acts before asking permission. WANTS: help Kest stop dangerous conversion, then settle fellowship obligations. PRESSURE: terse, seeks real exits. KEY: plain irreverent answers, no riddles or water-survey explanations.
